title: Scioptic

inlines.v: SCIOP'TIC, adjective [Gr. shadow and to see.] Pertaining to the camera obscura, or to the art of exhibiting images through a hole in a darkened room. SCIOP'TIC, noun A sphere or globe with a lens made to turn like the eye; used in experiments with the camera obscura.
